verdict.rationale: Whether an email-sending service's source is available under an open license is a fair question to ask, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows that Amazon SES's source code is published or openly licensed. The pack covers only API, SMTP, receiving, monitoring and pricing features, plus llms.txt and markdown docs probes, none of which concern source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
